name: Baiyinosaurus
isnote: Described as showing transitional features between basal thyreophorans and stegosaurs (Li et al. 2024); its position relative to Huayangosauridae is not settled in the sources used.
sum: Baiyinosaurus is a basal stegosaur from the Middle Jurassic Wangjiashan Formation of Gansu, China, known from a partial skeleton with cranial bones.
holotype: IVPG-D021, a partial skeleton with fragments of the left premaxilla, maxilla, frontals, jugal, squamosal and dentary, an atlas, seven dorsal vertebrae and a caudal vertebra — Wangjiashan Formation, Gansu.
biology: As a stegosaur it would have been a quadrupedal herbivore with plates and spines along the neck, back and tail; no direct evidence is given.
author: Li et al. 2024
